candidates.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
candidates.summary: Learn how OpenAI scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver 12× faster reads for ChatGPT.

candidates.title: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI: A hands-on guide
candidates.summary: Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning (MTRL) on Amazon SageMaker AI trains models on the outcome of a whole multi-step task rather than labeled steps. This hands-on guide walks the full pipeline using Wordle: deploying the agent and reward on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, preparing the dataset, training, and evaluating at serving settings.

candidates.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
candidates.summary: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.

candidates.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
candidates.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.

candidates.title: Visualize points and routes with GeoJSON in Amazon Quick Sight layer maps
candidates.summary: Amazon Quick Sight layer maps now support Point and LineString geometry from the same GeoJSON workflow, so you can plot store locations and the routes between them. This post covers the dataset and GeoJSON structure layer maps require, when to choose points or lines, and techniques for viewport control, layering geometries, and dynamic GeoJSON updates.
